encyclopedia.summary: A Korean webtoon written by Lee Hyeon-min and drawn by Kim Hyeon-su, serialised from 2021. A civil engineering student wakes as Lloyd, heir to a ruined estate, and pulls it out of poverty with engineering knowledge. Drainage, roads and building materials do the work that magic usually does.
highlights: The estate is saved by civil engineering rather than magic, so every solution has a concrete basis.
It turns the isekai premise's information advantage into visible business results.
Lloyd's face acting carries the comedy and the stakes at once.
